description: A four-plane decentralized election architecture: blind-signature eligibility credentials, homomorphic exact tallying, hash-chained custody with threshold decryption, and a hyperdimensional shadow cross-check, synchronized over an off-grid LoRa mesh. Version 2.0 supersedes an HDC-only first draft withdrawn after technical review.
title: A Layered Decentralized Architecture for Election Integrity: Exact Tallies, Tamper-Evident Custody, and a Hyperdimensional Shadow Check
